problems.statement: For $n \ge 2$, $1 < p < \infty$ and $\delta > 0$, the Bochner–Riesz multiplier $(1 - |\xi|^2)_+^\delta$ is a bounded Fourier multiplier on $L^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$ if and only if $\delta > \delta(p) = \max(n|1/p - 1/2| - 1/2, 0)$. The condition is known to be necessary; the conjecture is proved for $n = 2$ and open for $n \ge 3$. problems.statement: Rudnick–Sarnak quantum unique ergodicity conjecture on the distribution of large-frequency eigenfunctions of the Laplacian on a negatively-curved manifold: on a compact Riemannian manifold of negative sectional curvature, every sequence of $L^2$-normalized Laplace eigenfunctions $\varphi_j$ with eigenvalues tending to infinity satisfies $|\varphi_j|^2\,d\mathrm{vol} \to d\mathrm{vol}/\mathrm{vol}(M)$ weakly (indeed their microlocal lifts converge to the Liouville measure): there is no exceptional subsequence. Proved by Lindenstrauss for Hecke eigenfunctions on arithmetic hyperbolic surfaces and by Holowinsky and Soundararajan for holomorphic Hecke eigenforms of increasing weight.

problems.statement:
**Prime labelings of grid graphs.** A prime labeling of a graph with $N$ vertices assigns the labels $1, 2, \ldots, N$ bijectively to its vertices so that any two adjacent vertices get coprime labels. Conjecture (Sundaram, Ponraj and Somasundaram, 2006): every planar grid graph $P_m \times P_n$ has a prime labeling.

Known: ladders ($m = 2$, Dean; Ghorbani–Kamali), $P_p \times P_n$ for a prime $p$ and $n \le p$ (Sundaram et al.), and $p < n \le p^2$ for an odd prime $p$ (Curran, 2022). The $3 \times n$ case is known only conditionally (Ollis–Curran, assuming Goldbach and a strong Lemoine conjecture). Labelings have been found by computer search up to $115 \times 115$.
problems.title: Prime labelings of grid graphs
